```{python}
from itertools import combinations
from math import cos, pi, sin, sqrt
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def polygon_points(points):
    return " ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x, y in points)


def hexagon(cx, cy, radius):
    return [
        (cx + radius * cos(pi * angle / 3), cy + radius * sin(pi * angle / 3))
        for angle in range(6)
    ]


def clip_polygon_to_half_plane(polygon, a, b, c):
    """Keep points satisfying a*x + b*y <= c."""
    clipped = []
    for start, end in zip(polygon, polygon[1:] + polygon[:1]):
        start_value = a * start[0] + b * start[1] - c
        end_value = a * end[0] + b * end[1] - c
        start_inside = start_value <= 1e-9
        end_inside = end_value <= 1e-9

        if start_inside and end_inside:
            clipped.append(end)
        elif start_inside != end_inside:
            ratio = start_value / (start_value - end_value)
            intersection = (
                start[0] + ratio * (end[0] - start[0]),
                start[1] + ratio * (end[1] - start[1]),
            )
            clipped.append(intersection)
            if end_inside:
                clipped.append(end)
    return clipped


def voronoi_cells(generators, bounds):
    left, top, right, bottom = bounds
    frame = [(left, top), (right, top), (right, bottom), (left, bottom)]
    cells = []
    for index, (px, py) in enumerate(generators):
        cell = frame
        for other_index, (qx, qy) in enumerate(generators):
            if index == other_index:
                continue
            a = 2 * (qx - px)
            b = 2 * (qy - py)
            c = qx * qx + qy * qy - px * px - py * py
            cell = clip_polygon_to_half_plane(cell, a, b, c)
        cells.append(cell)
    return cells


def circumcircle(first, second, third):
    ax, ay = first
    bx, by = second
    cx, cy = third
    denominator = 2 * (ax * (by - cy) + bx * (cy - ay) + cx * (ay - by))
    if abs(denominator) < 1e-9:
        return None
    ux = (
        (ax * ax + ay * ay) * (by - cy)
        + (bx * bx + by * by) * (cy - ay)
        + (cx * cx + cy * cy) * (ay - by)
    ) / denominator
    uy = (
        (ax * ax + ay * ay) * (cx - bx)
        + (bx * bx + by * by) * (ax - cx)
        + (cx * cx + cy * cy) * (bx - ax)
    ) / denominator
    radius_squared = (ux - ax) ** 2 + (uy - ay) ** 2
    return ux, uy, radius_squared


def delaunay_edges(generators):
    edges = set()
    for triple in combinations(range(len(generators)), 3):
        circle = circumcircle(*(generators[index] for index in triple))
        if circle is None:
            continue
        ux, uy, radius_squared = circle
        others = (index for index in range(len(generators)) if index not in triple)
        if all(
            (generators[index][0] - ux) ** 2 + (generators[index][1] - uy) ** 2
            >= radius_squared - 1e-6
            for index in others
        ):
            edges.update(tuple(sorted(edge)) for edge in combinations(triple, 2))
    return sorted(edges)


width, height = 1600, 760
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Comparació de tessel·lacions regulars i irregulars</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Una graella quadrada agrega punts en unitats comunes, una malla hexagonal destaca sis veïns laterals homogenis i un esquema de Voronoi assigna dominis irregulars als punts generadors amb arestes de Delaunay entre veïns.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c5d0d5; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .heading { fill: #21313c; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #4f626b; font-size: 28px; }',
    '      .cell { fill: #edf3f5; stroke: #7b8d95; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .cell-low { fill: #d7e8ee; stroke: #7b8d95; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .cell-high { fill: #74abc1; stroke: #58747f; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .hex-neighbour { fill: #dcebdc; stroke: #4e8965; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .hex-centre { fill: #e8b17f; stroke: #a65a35; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .voronoi-a { fill: #d7e8ee; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .voronoi-b { fill: #e8dce8; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .voronoi-c { fill: #e8e4c7; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .voronoi-d { fill: #dcebdc; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .voronoi-e { fill: #f0dacf; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .event { fill: #a63f2c; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .generator { fill: #21313c; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .delaunay { stroke: #6e4e80; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 10 8; fill: none; }',
    '      .count { fill: #21313c; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '    </style>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <rect width="1600" height="760" fill="#f7f9fa"/>',
]

for x in (20, 545, 1070):
    svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="25" width="510" height="710" class="panel"/>')

# Square grid with observed points and counts.
svg.append('  <text x="275" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Graella quadrada</text>')
square_counts = {(0, 2): 1, (1, 1): 2, (1, 3): 1, (2, 2): 3, (3, 0): 1, (3, 3): 2, (4, 1): 1}
for col in range(5):
    for row in range(5):
        x = 85 + col * 75
        y = 130 + row * 85
        count = square_counts.get((col, row), 0)
        css_class = "cell-high" if count >= 2 else "cell-low" if count == 1 else "cell"
        svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="75" height="85" class="{css_class}"/>')
        svg.append(f'  <text x="{x + 37.5}" y="{y + 52}" text-anchor="middle" class="count">{count}</text>')
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="275" y="588" text-anchor="middle" class="note">recomptes comparables</text>',
    '  <text x="275" y="623" text-anchor="middle" class="note">però sensibles a mida,</text>',
    '  <text x="275" y="658" text-anchor="middle" class="note">origen i orientació</text>',
])

# Hexagonal neighbourhood.
svg.append('  <text x="800" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Graella hexagonal</text>')
radius = 42
centre = (3, 2)
neighbours = {(2, 2), (2, 1), (3, 1), (4, 1), (4, 2), (3, 3)}
for col in range(6):
    for row in range(5):
        cx = 625 + col * 1.5 * radius
        cy = 165 + (row + 0.5 * (col % 2)) * sqrt(3) * radius
        css_class = "hex-centre" if (col, row) == centre else "hex-neighbour" if (col, row) in neighbours else "cell"
        svg.append(f'  <polygon points="{polygon_points(hexagon(cx, cy, radius))}" class="{css_class}"/>')
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="800" y="605" text-anchor="middle" class="note">sis veïns que comparteixen costat</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="640" text-anchor="middle" class="note">a igual distància entre centres</text>',
])

# Voronoi partition and its dual Delaunay neighbourhood from one point set.
svg.append('  <text x="1325" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Voronoi i Delaunay</text>')
generators = [(1190, 220), (1405, 210), (1190, 430), (1415, 380), (1370, 505)]
region_classes = ["voronoi-a", "voronoi-b", "voronoi-c", "voronoi-d", "voronoi-e"]
for points, css_class in zip(voronoi_cells(generators, (1110, 130, 1540, 555)), region_classes):
    svg.append(f'  <polygon points="{polygon_points(points)}" class="{css_class}"/>')
for first, second in delaunay_edges(generators):
    x1, y1 = generators[first]
    x2, y2 = generators[second]
    svg.append(f'  <line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" class="delaunay"/>')
for x, y in generators:
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="12" class="generator"/>')
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1325" y="605" text-anchor="middle" class="note">domini del generador més pròxim</text>',
    '  <text x="1325" y="640" text-anchor="middle" class="note">i veïnatge geomètric dual</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="700" text-anchor="middle" class="note">Cap d’aquestes estructures incorpora per si sola població, barreres, capacitat ni temps de recorregut.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/spatial-tessellations.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
